ai_overview_text:
Top vacation rentals in Santa Cruz County range from beach houses near the Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk to quiet redwoods cabins in Felton. HomeToGo | Vacation Rentals +1
Top Vacation Rentals & Neighborhoods
The Boardwalk Haven4.9(30)Vacation rentalWebsiteA modern, high-rated 9.8/10 home ideal for staying close to the Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk and West Cliff Drive.Brand New Luxury Capitola Village Home5.0(3)Vacation rentalWebsiteRated 9.4/10, situated steps away from the colorful shops, restaurants, and historic vibe of Capitola Village.Harbor House A (Eastside Santa Cruz)Rated 9.0/10, offering immediate access to the Santa Cruz Harbor and Twin Lakes Beach.Fern River Resort$1154.5(404)2-star hotelCallDirectionsWebsiteRated 9.2/10, a scenic creekside redwoods retreat if you prefer the mountains and trees over the ocean.Kendall & Potter / Local Curated HomesProperties like Black Pearl Cottage and Vicky by the Sea in Seabright offer pet-friendly amenities, full kitchens, and 2-to-4-bedroom layouts for families. Kendall & Potter +2
Nightly Rates: Standard rentals average around $530 per night during peak summer (July) and drop to about $389 per night in the off-peak season (November), with budget options starting around $89 to $183+ per night.
Discounts: Weekly or monthly stays often qualify for 10% to 19% off standard rates. Expedia +2
Santa Cruz (Westside / Seabright / Pleasure Point): Best for surfing, walking to the Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk, and coastal dining.
Capitola: Best for a storybook seaside village atmosphere, pastel architecture, and calm beach areas.
Aptos / La Selva Beach: Best for a quieter, more relaxed coastal experience close to state parks like Forest of Nisene Marks.
Felton / Santa Cruz Mountains: Best for a rustic, tree-lined forest escape among giant redwoods. Kendall & Potter +6
Pets: Look specifically for pet-friendly listings (common in areas like Seabright and Pleasure Point).
Parking & Logistics: Driveway or garage parking is crucial if you plan to surf or visit busy spots like Steamer Lane or the Boardwalk.
Hot Tubs & Outdoor Decks: Very popular for evening relaxation after a day at the beach or hiking. Cozycozy +2
Peak Season (May–August / September): Warmest weather and highest demand/prices.
Shoulder & Off-Peak (November–February): Lower nightly rates and longer-stay discounts, though weather is cooler and rainier. Homes & Villas by Marriott Bonvoy +2
If you tell me your group size, budget per night, and whether you prefer oceanfront or the redwoods, I can narrow down specific properties for you.
